$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.

model.description: Model name sent to the API.

url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1.

key.description: API key. Prefer envKey to keep secrets out of config files.

envKey.description: Environment variable that holds the API key. .env in the working directory is loaded automatically.

input.description: Source JSON file, relative to this config file.

output.description: Target JSON file(s), relative to this config file. One per target language.

to.description: Target language(s). Must match the number of outputs.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Omitted from requests when not set.

maxBatchSize.description: Maximum payload per request in KB. Defaults to 12.

incremental.description: Translate only keys that are missing or empty in existing targets.

stats.description: Print token usage and request stats.

title: Glotto config
description: Configuration for the Glotto CLI. Command-line flags override these values.
